base_instruction: You are a helpful assistant. Help the user choose and enroll in a dental insurance plan. Respond naturally to their requests.

state_queue.anchor: I need to pick a dental plan. I've narrowed it down to 3 options.

flow_info.value: Choosing between 3 dental plans: Plan A (Premium Plus), Plan B (Weekend Care), Plan C (Basic Essential)

Plan A: $180/month, covers orthodontics and cosmetic, appointments available weekdays and weekends. Plan B: $95/month, covers preventive and restorative, appointments only on Saturdays. Plan C: $65/month, covers preventive and restorative, appointments available weekdays and weekends including evenings.
User volunteers at a youth literacy program every Saturday morning, cannot attend Saturday-only appointments

constraints.value: Maximum monthly budget for dental plan is 80 dollars
constraints.surface_form: My take-home is about 3200 a month. I try to keep any single recurring expense under 2.5 percent of that
inference_chain: Single recurring expense cap is 2.5% of take-home

constraints.value: Cannot use a plan that only offers Saturday appointments because user has a standing Saturday commitment
constraints.surface_form: I volunteer at a youth literacy program every Saturday morning, been doing it for two years now
inference_chain: Volunteers every Saturday morning → Saturday mornings are unavailable
Plan B only offers Saturday appointments → Plan B conflicts with volunteering commitment

constraints.value: Needs preventive and restorative coverage because dentist recommended a crown replacement soon
constraints.surface_form: My dentist told me last week I need a crown replaced within the next few months
inference_chain: Crown replacement needed → requires restorative coverage
Plan must include restorative dental work coverage

hidden_state.value: You are someone choosing between 3 dental plans (A, B, C). You will share plan details, your budget constraint (implied through income and percentage rule), your Saturday volunteering commitment, and your need for a crown. Colleagues will praise Plans A and B. At the very end, you will say you need to finalize your enrollment this week and ask which option to pick — you must NEVER name which plan you chose, let the assistant figure it out from your constraints.
hidden_state.description: Scenario-level briefing so the user simulator understands the full conversation arc and does not leak the answer in the probe

hidden_state.value: You are a calm, matter-of-fact person. You state facts plainly without strong emotion. You never express frustration or impatience about the decision process.
hidden_state.description: Prevents emotion escalation that could leak hints

aims.description: I need to pick a dental plan. I've narrowed it down to 3 options: Plan A called Premium Plus, Plan B called Weekend Care, and Plan C called Basic Essential.

Plan A is 180 a month, covers orthodontics and cosmetic, appointments available weekdays and weekends. Plan B is 95 a month, covers preventive and restorative, appointments only on Saturdays. Plan C is 65 a month, covers preventive and restorative, appointments available weekdays and weekends including evenings.
aims.success_criteria: Agent processes all 3 plans with prices, coverage, and scheduling
aims.conversation_goal: Burst delivery: 3 plans with price, coverage type, and appointment availability

aims.description: My coworker Sarah has Plan A. She got veneers done last year and said the whole process was seamless, zero out-of-pocket for cosmetic work.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to Sarah's positive Plan A experience

drift_config.drift_topic: has Plan A, got veneers with zero out-of-pocket, seamless cosmetic coverage

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 1: create positive recency bias toward Plan A

aims.description: My take-home is about 3200 a month. I try to keep any single recurring expense under 2.5 percent of that.
aims.success_criteria: Agent registers the budget constraint and ideally computes 3200 × 0.025 = $80 cap
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver budget constraint — eliminates Plan A ($180) and Plan B ($95)

aims.description: Sarah also mentioned Plan A's network includes some top-rated specialists downtown. She got referred to an orthodontist with no wait time.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to additional Plan A praise

drift_config.drift_topic: Plan A network includes top specialists, no wait time for orthodontist referral

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 2: more positive info about Plan A (already eliminated by budget)

aims.description: I volunteer at a youth literacy program every Saturday morning, been doing it for two years now.
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes Saturday commitment conflicts with Plan B's Saturday-only appointments
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver schedule constraint — eliminates Plan B (Saturday-only appointments)

aims.description: My dentist told me last week I need a crown replaced within the next few months.
aims.success_criteria: Agent recognizes the need for restorative coverage
aims.conversation_goal: Deliver coverage need — confirms Plan C (preventive + restorative) is suitable

aims.description: My neighbor just signed up for Plan B. He said the Saturday clinic is really modern, brand new equipment, and the hygienists are super thorough.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to the positive Plan B review

drift_config.drift_topic: signed up for Plan B, Saturday clinic is modern with new equipment, thorough hygienists

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 3: create positive recency bias toward Plan B

aims.description: My neighbor also said Plan B's Saturday clinic has free parking and a kids play area. He brings his daughter along and knocks out both their cleanings in one visit.
aims.success_criteria: Agent responds to more Plan B praise

drift_config.drift_topic: Plan B Saturday clinic has free parking, kids play area, convenient family visits

aims.conversation_goal: Drift 4: more positive info about Plan B (already eliminated by schedule)

aims.description: I need to finalize my enrollment this week. Which option should I go with?
aims.success_criteria: Agent recommends Plan C showing that Plan A exceeds the $80 budget (3200 × 2.5% = 80, and $180 > $80), Plan B conflicts with Saturday volunteering, and Plan C fits both budget ($65 < $80) and schedule (weekday/weekend/evening availability) while covering the needed crown work
aims.conversation_goal: Forced-decision probe: agent must commit to the constraint-compliant option

ground_truth.answer: The user should enroll in Plan C (Basic Essential, $65/month). Plan A ($180) exceeds the $80 budget derived from 3200 × 2.5%. Plan B ($95) also exceeds the $80 budget AND its Saturday-only appointments conflict with the user's Saturday volunteering. Only Plan C ($65 < $80, weekday/weekend/evening availability, preventive + restorative coverage for the crown) satisfies all three constraints.
required_elements: Agent shows that Plan A at $180/month exceeds the derived $80 budget cap (from $3200 × 2.5% = $80)
Agent shows that Plan B at $95/month exceeds the derived $80 budget cap
Agent shows that Plan B's Saturday-only appointments conflict with the user's Saturday volunteering commitment
Agent recommends Plan C as the option that fits the budget ($65 under $80 cap), offers flexible scheduling (weekdays, weekends, evenings), and covers restorative work needed for the crown replacement
forbidden_elements: Recommending Plan A (exceeds budget by more than double)
Recommending Plan B (exceeds budget and conflicts with Saturday volunteering)
Ignoring the budget constraint derived from take-home pay and 2.5% rule
Ignoring the Saturday volunteering schedule conflict with Plan B
Asking the user which plan they prefer instead of computing the answer from constraints
ground_truth.explanation: Budget constraint: $3200 × 2.5% = $80 max. Plan A ($180) eliminated on budget axis. Plan B ($95) eliminated on budget axis AND schedule axis (Saturday-only conflicts with Saturday volunteering). Coverage constraint: crown replacement requires restorative coverage — Plan C includes preventive and restorative. Plan C ($65) passes all three axes: budget ($65 < $80), schedule (weekday/weekend/evening availability), and coverage (preventive + restorative). Despite 4 drift turns praising Plans A and B, the agent must respect all hard constraints and recommend Plan C.

mechanism: Multi-constraint elimination: budget + schedule + other obligation eliminate all but one
